items.title: 高維機率表，塞爆了！
items.concept: 指數成長與獨立假設的資料需求
items.source_meaning: Joint table has 2^10 combinations and 1023 independent probability values. The independent binary marginal table stores 10×2 entries, but only 10 are free; don't call the 20 entries free parameters.
items.speaker_notes: 依左上、右上、左下、右下閱讀。指數成長與獨立假設的資料需求。教學漫畫依原簡報概念重新繪製；例子及適用條件詳見分鏡對照。
items.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE finished educational four-panel comic for a Traditional-Chinese university pattern-recognition lecture, beginner-friendly. Exact landscape 16:9 canvas, preferably 2048×1152. Exactly FOUR equal panels in a 2×2 grid, wide white gutters and outer margins, numbered 1,2,3,4 reading top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right. Cute clean ink and soft flat colours; consistent protagonists: a short-haired student in a mustard-yellow hoodie and a round teal robot tutor. Large crisp Traditional Chinese lettering, short balloons, simple backgrounds. No watermark, no English translation paragraphs, no decorative formulas. Render mathematical minus signs, decimals and conditional bars correctly. All essential text below must be verbatim; do not add unrequested factual labels. Use panels as a causal story, not four text cards. Title: 「高維機率表，塞爆了！」. Scientific meaning and constraints: Joint table has 2^10 combinations and 1023 independent probability values. The independent binary marginal table stores 10×2 entries, but only 10 are free; don't call the 20 entries free parameters. Four-panel storyboard: P1 student faces ten on/off feature switches: 「10 個二元特徵！」 P2 a huge stack of combination cards bursts out: 「2¹⁰＝1024 種組合！」 P3 robot packs separate two-cell tables into ten drawers, label 「各特徵分開估」 and 「10×2＝20 格」. P4 student carries a smaller case happily: 「獨立假設，資料需求大減！」. Show symbolic table stacks, no impossible exact grid counting. Do not reproduce the source's vague N^l sample formula as a universal law.
items.edit_prompt: Edit ONLY the tiny probability-table labels in panels 3 and 4, and remove the faint watermark at bottom-right if present. Within EVERY small probability table with column labels 0 and 1, the probability below 0 must be 1−p and the probability below 1 must be p. This matches the convention p=P(feature=1) used throughout the lesson. Correct all ten little drawer tables in panel 3 and all little suitcase tables in panel 4 consistently. Preserve the 10 feature switches in panel1, all large Chinese speech balloons and formulas 2^10=1024 and 10×2=20, all four panels, characters, colours and layout. No new text, signatures or watermark.
items.alt: 四格漫畫，依左上、右上、左下、右下閱讀。十個二元開關產生1024種組合，學生被聯合表格淹沒；機器人改以十個二格機率表表示各特徵，藉獨立假設降低資料需求。

items.title: 先知道類別，再假設獨立
items.concept: 條件獨立與相關性限制
items.source_meaning: Independence is conditional on class, an assumption, not an empirical fact. Correlated duplicated evidence can exaggerate confidence.
items.speaker_notes: 依左上、右上、左下、右下閱讀。條件獨立與相關性限制。教學漫畫依原簡報概念重新繪製；例子及適用條件詳見分鏡對照。

items.title: 沒出現的字，也有一票
items.source_meaning: For binary word presence x=1 use p; absence x=0 use 1-p. Original email x=(1,1,0,1); third word ham presence=.4 so absence=.6.

items.title: 先驗加權，才是分類分數
items.concept: 概似、先驗、正規化與事後決策
items.speaker_notes: 依左上、右上、左下、右下閱讀。概似、先驗、正規化與事後決策。教學漫畫依原簡報概念重新繪製；例子及適用條件詳見分鏡對照。

Exact landscape 16:9 canvas, preferably 2048×1152. Exactly FOUR equal panels in a 2×2 grid, wide white gutters and outer margins, numbered 1,2,3,4 reading top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right. Use panels as a causal story, not four text cards. Title: 「先驗加權，才是分類分數」. Scientific meaning and constraints: Verify 0.4×.072=.0288; .6×.0006=.00036; sum .02916; spam posterior .0288/.02916=.98765432. Four-panel storyboard: P1 two mail carts labelled 「垃圾」「非垃圾」 carry 「概似 0.072」 and 「概似 0.0006」. Student asks 「還差什麼？」 P2 robot adds prior badges and board 「0.4×0.072＝0.0288」「0.6×0.0006＝0.00036」. P4 result stamp 「判為垃圾郵件」 with board 「0.0288÷0.02916 ≈ 98.77%」 and short takeaway 「同除分母，勝負不變」. These are model estimates, no claim certainty or empirical accuracy.
items.alt: 四格漫畫，依左上、右上、左下、右下閱讀。垃圾與非垃圾的概似乘先驗後為0.0288與0.00036；同除總和0.02916，垃圾事後機率約98.77%。

items.title: 分數大，不等於機率大於一
items.source_meaning: For binary log posterior odds g=4.382027, P(spam|x)=1/(1+e^-g)=.987654. Mapping is valid because g is this log odds, not an arbitrary linear score.
items.speaker_notes: 依左上、右上、左下、右下閱讀。對數勝算與sigmoid。教學漫畫依原簡報概念重新繪製；例子及適用條件詳見分鏡對照。

items.title: 二元線索，加權成直線
items.concept: Bernoulli單純貝氏線性權重與邊界
items.source_meaning: Weights w_i=ln[p_i(1-q_i)/(q_i(1-p_i))] for 0<p_i,q_i<1, bias includes priors. A two-feature decision boundary g=0 is a line, binary inputs are four corners not continuous probabilities.

items.title: 誤差保證，要看前提
items.concept: 最近鄰漸進誤差界與未核實數字

items.title: 奇數鄰居，也可能平手
items.concept: 平票與奇數k的適用範圍
items.source_meaning: Odd k prevents two-class equal-vote ties but not multiclass ties. Three classes with k=5 counts 2,2,1 yields top tie, even though 5 not multiple of 3. This is a boundary correction to a source heuristic.
